repo_meta_data.description: WebTau (web test automation) is a testing API, command line tool and a framework to write unit, integration and end-to-end tests. Test across REST-API, WebSocket, GraphQL, Browser, Database, CLI and Business Logic with a consistent set of matchers and concepts. REPL mode speeds-up tests development. Rich reporting cuts down investigation time.
